about.founded: Ganesh Electricals was established in 1997 by Mr. B.Kumareson to further enhance and capitalise on his strong background and knowledge of the Power Distribution and Transmission sector.
about.note: Mr.Kumareson has past experience in Tamilnadu government establishment.
about.purpose: To undertake specialized turnkey industrial electrification projects and power the industrial sector of our nation.
introduction: GANESH ELECTRICALS, an electrical engineering and contracting company established in 1997 to provide quality, safety, reliability and timely completion of projects. GANESH ELECTRICALS has successfully managed to carve its niche in the field of electrical engineering and contracting in India.

We wish to introduce ourselves as one of the prosperous electrical contractors in Chennai carrying out electrical design & installation on turnkey basis for valuable clients from 230KV, 110kV EHV substations to 33KV, 11kV Installation, up to downstream electrical works including plant, machinery and office electrification works.
about.capability: We are authorized to carryout all electrical works with no limitation in type of voltage or capacity. We have executed turnkey projects in various categories based on Voltage level 230KV, 110KV, 33kV & 11KV.
localIssues: Ganesh Electricals has rich experience executing projects in Pillaipakkam, Oragadam, Vallam vadagal and neighboring area. We've good public, industrial relation and good rapport with local and district administration authorities.
We don't entertain any issues affecting project work. In case of any unforeseen issues, it's our responsibility to resolve it amicably without disturbing our client.

serve: Provide quality, safety, reliability and timely completion of projects
Follow client's rules and regulation without compromising statutory and industrial norms.

roles.title: Proprietor
responsibilities: Strategic business planning
Policy decisions
Provide adequate resources
authorities: Authority to approve decisions, hire and fire

roles.title: Head Projects
responsibilities: Interact with customer to get project requirements
Plan execution based on requirements and time schedules
Effective utilization of manpower and machines
Simulate & evaluate contingency plan
Review Project status and address bottle necks & issues
Ensure on time project handover
authorities: Authority to approve changes in project activities.

roles.title: Technical head
responsibilities: Identify requirements (customer, statutory, legal..)and ensure electrical design meet the same
Interact with customer to understand the requirements
Participate in project feasibility analysis
Implement quality controls to ensure compliance with customer requirements
Design and validate before handover to customer
Prepare schedule and monitor progress of projects
Co-ordinate with project team and ensure successful project completion
Maintain design records
authorities: Authority to be single point of contact for projects

roles.title: Purchase
responsibilities: Identify & evaluate suppliers / sub contractors for material, special process and services
Negotiate cost and delivery terms with existing and new supplier
Release P.O and follow up material delivery
Audit existing and supplier
Evaluate supplier performance and interact for improvement.
authorities: Authority to disqualify a supplier / sub contractor

roles.title: Safety Engineer
responsibilities: Provide health and safety measures
Identification of environmental aspects and determining the project objectives and target
Identify and evaluate the unsafe environment and practices
Identify the root causes of safety and industrial hygiene
Develop hazard control processes, methods and programs
Recommend solutions to issues that need improvement
Advise several ways of controlling potential threats
Monitor implementation of safety plans according to plans and objectives
Monitor and track safety systems by using computer systems and spreadsheets
Communicate plans and strategies across the entire business unit from time to time
Maintain and manage equipment and processes related to each project of health and safety
Suggest several preventive methods and practices like recycling, waste disposal, pollution control, etc.
Collaborate with other levels of engineering staff, quality assurance, quality improvement, regulatory compliance specialists, etc.
Measure and audit the effectiveness of hazard control programs
Prepare future safety plans based on past experiences and facts
authorities: Authority to stop any work in the event of potential serious violation.
Authority to communicate with customer regarding safety issues

roles.title: Quality Engineer
responsibilities: Inspect all incoming material, job work & special process material
Maintain incoming inspection records
Inspect site work task against MS & customer, statutory requirements.
Maintain site work inspection records
Inspect finished work as per client requirement
Maintain master list of measuring and monitoring devices
Ensure all measuring and monitoring devices are calibrated
Interact with customer regarding quality requirements and any issues
Register customer / site complaints and initiate CAPA
authorities: Authority to block suspected lots and escalate
Stop site work if MS & other requirements are not met.
Authority to block/discard any measuring equipment if found defective.
Authority to communicate with customer regarding quality issues
